title: Guitar practice log
content: Working in DADGAD tuning. Twenty minutes of scales daily, then the Bert Jansch arrangement.

title: Flat viewing notes
content: Oosterpark, third floor, no lift. South facing living room, bright in the afternoon. Asking 475k, service charge 180 a month. The kitchen was redone in 2024 and the boiler is new. Bike storage in the basement is shared with twelve flats, and the neighbour mentioned the stairwell gets repainted every spring. Bos en Lommer, ground floor, cheaper at 390k, but there was visible damp along the back wall of the rear bedroom and the smell did not clear when the window was open.
